title: PoE PCB fabrication readiness is not assembly or compliance readiness
rootCause: A PoE-style PCB can have DRC 0 and ERC 0 while still lacking supplier stock verification and safety/compliance engineering review.
fixSummary: Represent PoE REV_D as PCB_FAB_READY while keeping ASSEMBLY_READY_NOT_VERIFIED, BLOCKED_SOURCING, and BLOCKED_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW until live verification and review are complete.
